# Arjun Rao — Director of Quality

- **Relationship:** cross-org. Runs corporate Quality across the network; partners with
  Operations but reports independently to preserve objectivity.
- **Cadence:** weekly quality review; monthly with Ray on scrap and warranty trends.
- **Owns:** the **scrap-rate reduction** stream inside the
  [OEE program](../projects/operational-excellence.md) — scrap is **3.8%** vs a **< 2.5% target**.
- **Distinguishing fact:** traced a chunk of pump scrap to **porosity in Cascade Castings**
  ductile iron — a quality thread that also touches the single-source supply risk
  ([Bob Nguyen](bob-nguyen.md)).

## How to work with him
- Data-first; will not sign off on a corrective action without measurement.
- The person to ask about scrap root cause and supplier quality.

## Sensitivities
- Wants supplier-quality leverage over Cascade that the single-source position currently denies.
